info.title: Tamin Electronic Prescription Services API - Test Endpoints
info.description:
OpenAPI specification derived from the Persian technical guide for Social Security Organization (Tamin) electronic prescription services. Production endpoints are used as canonical paths; test endpoints are preserved in x-testUrl / x-testPath vendor extensions where they differ. Where the source document does not define exact response payloads, responses are intentionally broad.

This variant was generated from the canonical production specification by promoting each operation's x-testUrl to the actual OpenAPI path used for test endpoints. Operation schemas, request bodies, responses, tags, and security settings are preserved where possible. Path and query parameters were aligned with the test endpoint templates so code generators such as Kiota can produce a client that calls the test URLs directly.

OAuth2PKCE.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with PKCE as described in the source document.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer access token returned by the token service. Header usage is inferred from OAuth practice.

GenericApiResponse.description: Generic response wrapper used in examples. Many endpoints do not define a complete response schema in the source.

ErrorResponse.description: Error model inferred from response examples and validation messages in the source document.

grant_type.description: The PDF prose uses code_authorization/type_grant; cURL examples use authorization_code/grant_type.

verifier_code.description: Alias name used in older prose.

AuthorizationCodeTokenV2Request.description: V2 token request; includes audience and returns refresh token.

token_refresh.description: Alias used in the Persian text.

audience.description: National code or identifier of the entity for whom the token is issued.

prescTypeId.description: 1 drug, 2 paraclinic, 3 visit, 5 services, 6 referential services, 7 physician referral, 8 referral feedback, 9 hospitalization order

parGrpCode.description: 000 unspecified, 001 pathology, 002 genetics, 003 global genetics, 004 medical diagnosis

terminology.description: If BEHDASHT.thritha is sent, service code follows Ministry of Health coding.

DiagnosisID.description: The PDF table says integer, while examples use ICD-like strings.

complaintIDs.description: Comma-separated complaint IDs per formal table.

repeat.description: Drug repeat period; repeat count cannot exceed 3 according to notes.

illnessId.description: Physiotherapy illness ID; multiple values comma-separated.

planId.description: Physiotherapy plan ID; multiple values comma-separated.

toothId.description: FDI tooth code when service depends on a tooth.

mobile.description: Patient mobile number; appears in examples and validation notes.

docId.description: Medical council number without symbols; midwives use * for Persian letter م.

docNationalCode.description: Doctor national code; foreign doctors use FDA-prefixed FIDA code.

clientId.description: Required in the test environment; send doctor national code according to PDF.

siamId.description: Required for clinic/hospital/nurse or hospitalization scenarios.

ID_EPRSC_head.description: Unique prescription header ID mentioned as output of registration service.
